pages.text: 早上，妈妈告诉咘咘：“今天猪猪姐姐要来玩，下午吃冰淇淋，晚上看冰雪奇缘。”咘咘的眼睛一下子亮了：“真的吗？真的吗？”
pages.text_en: In the morning, Mummy told Bubu, "Today Zhuzhu is coming to play. In the afternoon there will be ice cream, and Frozen in the evening." Bubu's eyes lit up. "Really? Really?"

pages.text: 咘咘蹦蹦跳跳，心砰砰跳，裙子转成了一朵花。她大声说：“我好开心！我好开心！”NOMI 笑着说：“高兴的时候，身体就是想跳起来。”
pages.text_en: Bubu jumped up and down, her heart beating fast, her skirt spinning like a flower. She shouted, "I am so happy! I am so happy!" NOMI smiled. "When you are happy, your body just wants to jump."

pages.text: 猪猪姐姐来了！咘咘跑过去，拉着猪猪姐姐的手：“猪猪姐姐，我们一起玩！”两个人搭积木、画画、给玩偶办茶话会。
pages.text_en: Zhuzhu came! Bubu ran over and took Zhuzhu's hand. "Zhuzhu, let's play together!" They built blocks, drew pictures, and held a tea party for their dolls.

pages.text: 玩着玩着，咘咘跑得太快，差点撞到桌子。妈妈说：“开心的时候，身体也要慢一点，才玩得安全。”咘咘点点头，放慢了脚步。
pages.text_en: While playing, Bubu ran too fast and nearly bumped into the table. Mummy said, "When you are happy, your body still needs to slow down a little, so play stays safe." Bubu nodded and slowed her steps.

pages.text: 下午，冰淇淋店到了。咘咘拉着爸爸的手指着店门：“冰淇淋！冰淇淋！”爸爸笑着说：“我们买一个大大的，大家一起分。”
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, they reached the ice cream shop. Bubu pulled Daddy's hand and pointed at the door. "Ice cream! Ice cream!" Daddy smiled. "We will buy one big ice cream and share it with everyone."

pages.text: 妈妈拿出小碗，一勺一勺分冰淇淋，粉色的给咘咘，白色的给猪猪姐姐。咘咘捧着小碗，小心地舀了一勺：“好好吃呀！”
pages.text_en: Mummy took out small bowls and shared the ice cream spoon by spoon, pink for Bubu, white for Zhuzhu. Bubu held her bowl and carefully took a spoonful. "So yummy!"

pages.text: 咘咘看着猪猪姐姐吃得开心，自己也更开心了。NOMI 说：“高兴分出去，会变得更多。”NONO 啄了一口冰淇淋，抬头叫了一声。
pages.text_en: Bubu watched Zhuzhu enjoy her ice cream, and felt even happier herself. NOMI said, "When happiness is shared, it grows bigger." NONO pecked at the ice cream and chirped.

pages.text: 咘咘吃得太开心了，鼻子上沾了一大坨粉色的冰淇淋。大家都笑了，咘咘自己也咯咯咯地笑起来。
pages.text_en: Bubu enjoyed her ice cream so much that a big blob of pink ice cream landed on her nose. Everyone laughed, and Bubu giggled too.

pages.text: 晚上，一家人坐下来看冰雪奇缘。咘咘靠在妈妈身边，小声跟着唱，心里暖暖的，像出了大太阳。
pages.text_en: At night, the family sat down to watch Frozen. Bubu leaned against Mummy, humming softly, her heart warm like a big sun.

pages.text: Coco 说：“Happy！好开心！”咘咘说：“今天我好开心，因为猪猪姐姐来了，我们一起玩，还分了冰淇淋，看了冰雪奇缘。”
pages.text_en: Coco said, "Happy!" Bubu said, "Today I am so happy, because Zhuzhu came, we played together, we shared ice cream, and we watched Frozen."

pages.text: 妈妈说：“高兴可以慢慢享受，不用一下子全用完。明天，猪猪姐姐还会再来吗？”咘咘点点头：“我们可以再约！”
pages.text_en: Mummy said, "Happiness can be enjoyed slowly. It does not have to be used up all at once. Tomorrow, will Zhuzhu come again?" Bubu nodded. "We can plan it again!"

pages.text: 咘咘知道，高兴还会来。下一次，她可以先笑一笑，再慢慢玩，把高兴分给别人，自己也会更开心。
pages.text_en: Bubu knew happiness would come again. Next time, she could smile first, play slowly, share her happiness with others, and feel even happier herself.
